description: Pôle de Recherche de l’Activité Volcano-tectonique d’Auvergne et d’Ardèche (PROVA²) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OPGC. The ‘Pôle Régional d'Observation de l'activité Volcano-tectonique d'Auvergne et d'Ardèche (PROVA²)’ is an initiative of the Observatoire de Physique du Globe de Clermont-Ferrand (OPGC) and of the Laboratoire Magmas et Volcans (LMV), with the support from national (via the CNRS-INSU National Observation Services) and international collaborators, as well as Epos-Fr. Coverage: OPGC. The portal shows the English title as "Research Unit of the Volcano-Tectonic Activity of Auvergne and Ardèche (PROVA²)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OPGC. Its keywords include volcano-tectonic-activity, spatio-temporal-analyses, dataset, multi-methods-surveys, long-dormant-volcanic-provinces, geology. The listing shows 4 download or service links in DOI, 0-HTTP--LINK. The listing shows 2025-08-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
